_comment: Named run profiles for the migration orchestrator. Each profile defines which MIGRATE_* steps run and which DELETE_* steps run. Credentials/secrets stay in .env; behavior toggles live here. Resolution order at runtime is: defaults (all false) < selected profile < --set CLI overrides.

full-migration.description: End-to-end migration of all supported account configuration (no deletions).

post-user-migration.description: Run AFTER Frontegg Support has migrated your users: adds each user's remaining tenant memberships with their per-tenant roles, migrates groups and user attributes (lock state, phone, metadata), then migrates tenant API tokens (TENANT_API_TOKENS_MODE: recreate = NEW clientId/secret, preserve = original ones) and recreates user API tokens (NEW clientId/secret).

cutover-delta.description: Close the cutover gap: create users added in the source since the user export (WITHOUT passwords/MFA secrets - they must reset or use SSO), then fill in their memberships, groups, and attributes.

auth-policies-only.description: Migrate authentication/security policies only: MFA policy (incl. forced MFA), MFA methods, lockout, password complexity/history, captcha, session configuration, and per-tenant overrides.

groups-only.description: Migrate user groups only (group definitions, group roles, group members). Users must already exist in the destination for member sync.

user-attributes-only.description: Sync user attributes only: lock state, phone number, metadata, external ID. Users must already exist in the destination.

user-tenant-roles-only.description: Add missing user tenant memberships and per-tenant roles only. Safe to re-run.

api-tokens-only.description: Tenant and user API tokens only. Tenant tokens follow TENANT_API_TOKENS_MODE (recreate = NEW clientId/secret written to CSV, preserve = original clientId/secret); user tokens always get NEW clientId/secret, written to CSV.

roles-only.description: Migrate categories, permissions, and roles only.

delete-cleanup.description: DESTRUCTIVE: delete data from the destination account. No migration runs.
